facts.business: Ram Ratna Wires Limited manufactures winding wires, cables, and related products, and is setting up a new manufacturing facility at Bhiwadi, Rajasthan.

capacity_or_capex.item: New manufacturing facility at Bhiwadi, Rajasthan and capacity enhancement at existing plants

auditor.name: Bhagwagar Dalal & Doshi
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on tax demand of ₹6,790.77 Lakhs (excluding interest of ₹3,149.05 Lakhs) for AY 2021-22 to 2024-25 pursuant to search and seizure action u/s 132 of Income Tax Act, and reassessment notices u/s 148 for Global Copper Private Limited (merged) for AY 2019-20 and 2020-21. No adjustments made in financial statements.

key_risks: Tax demands and reassessment proceedings under Income Tax Act
High capital expenditure and execution risk for new Bhiwadi facility
Dependence on working capital loans with personal guarantees from promoters
